about: Pass 10 (2026-10-10): rows that the per-model ledger sources already publish for models that are in data/models.json but were never imported, the Bielik (SpeakLeash) rows from the Polish boards, and pass-8/9 gaps that only needed an identity check or one more row. Every pinned source file was re-read (inventory of 6,126 entries across 26 sources); unmapped entries were matched to catalogue models by exact Hugging Face repo (including documented repo renames: CohereForAI->CohereLabs, Meta-Llama-3.1->Llama-3.1, root-namespace gpt2/t5 -> openai-community/google-t5) or exact API id, and each source's existing picking rules and note style were reused (Open PT: hub, unflagged, bf16/fp16/fp32, main revision; EuroEval: 5-shot accuracy, one split per model, zero-shot API runs and near-chance cells not imported; Polish EQ-Bench: latest unquantised eq-bench_v2_pl run per model path; StableLM: committed evals/*.json). No new models and no new benchmark ids; one ledger add_match (StableLM eval file).
